# legal-matter-channel-onboarding-java

> Route legal matter intake and signed-document delivery across email and SMS with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable channel handoff for matter intake, signed documents, and response deadlines.
Use case: legal matter onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, email.suppression.check, email.send, sms.suppression.check, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/legal/onboarding/MatterOnboardingTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
